description: This file defines string replacement functions (`absl::StrReplaceAll`) for performing efficient large text substitutions, including overloads for different input types and in-place replacements. It includes internal structures and algorithms for managing substitutions.

classes.name: ViableSubstitution
classes.description: Internal structure representing a potential substitution with position and length for prioritization.

methods.name: StrReplaceAll
methods.description: Performs string replacements based on a list or container of key-value pairs, returning a new string.

methods.name: StrReplaceAll
methods.description: Performs in-place string replacements based on a list or container of key-value pairs, returning the number of substitutions.
